---
title: Shipping a new arcade cabinet build
compartment: recipe
scope: global
permalink: deploy-arcade
version: 2
---

- [step] Push the build to main; the cabinet pulls it at night (source: [[journal/2026-08-11]])
- [step] Toggle the cabinet power once the pull lands, or the old game keeps running (source: [[journal/2026-08-11]])
- [gotcha] A pull that reports success is not a running build; check the attract screen version (source: [[journal/2026-08-11]])
